samples.question: There are two far-separated square registers, each marked by a gold corner notch. Turn both registers until the notch is upper-left. For every corresponding cell of the aligned 8-by-8 rasters, write # when the mean RGB colors differ and . when they match. Read the resulting 8-by-8 difference bitmap and compare it with A) RING = 00111100/01100110/11000011/11000011/11000011/11000011/01100110/00111100 or B) CROSS = 10011001/00011000/00011000/11111111/11111111/00011000/00011000/10011001. Which symbol appears? Answer A or B.
